result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930). Scope: capacity accounting, spawn admission, queued/provisioning limits, fairness/oversubscription at 50/400. Two MEDIUM findings, both reproduced with local fake providers. F1 coordinator.ts:323-331: a revived failed worker enters 'booting' (line 239) and is charged to MAX_PROVISIONING, so 4 revivals block all new queued admission for up to 300s with 46/50 slots free. F2 coordinator.ts:800-804: fail() omits intent:null (cf. 776-782), so a pause racing an in-flight monitor step turns terminal 'failed' into non-terminal 'paused' (345, 851-855): no result, VM holds a slot forever. Sound: 400 workers/50 cap never oversubscribes (peak 50 VMs, 4 provisioning, FIFO), exact MAX_QUEUE boundary, request_id retry idempotency. Bun 1.4.2 lifecycle+core 44 pass/0 fail. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md + findings.json.
result.details:
TARGET d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 verified in a disposable detached clone at /tmp/opencode/rev01 (git rev-parse HEAD = target). /workspace/repo left at assigned baseline 5672ead and verified clean after reverting an accidental index update from my initial 'git --work-tree' checkout (see warnings; no commit, push, tag or branch change).

F1 (MEDIUM) src/coordinator.ts:323 - session revival consumes the provisioning budget. Trace: coordinator.ts:238-243 transitions a failed/recovery_required worker to 'booting' on send_worker_message (only 'completed' revives to 'ready'); coordinator.ts:323-325 counts all 'provisioning' OR 'booting' workers against SWARMFORGE_MAX_PROVISIONING; coordinator.ts:330-331 gates queued->provisioning on provisioning < MAX_PROVISIONING; queueMessage resets provision_started_at (line 242) and the only exit is the 300s provision timeout (lines 444-451). Reproduced (probe p2_booting_slot.ts, exit 0): 4 revived workers, fresh worker stuck 'queued' after 10 ticks, capacity accounting 4/50, provider VMs created 4. Bound confirmed in p3_bounds.ts (a). Uncovered by tests: tests/lifecycle.test.ts:666-678 asserts only the revived state, tests/helpers.ts:20-21 pins MAX_PROVISIONING=1 with a single worker, and tests/lifecycle.test.ts:40-54 only counts queued workers.

F2 (MEDIUM) src/coordinator.ts:800 - fail() does not clear a durable intent. Trace: step awaits provider.getWorker at line 487 (up to SWARMFORGE_API_TIMEOUT_MS, 30s default); control('pause') patches intent at line 833 then awaits exclusive() at line 834, which returns the in-flight promise instead of re-running step (lines 251-257); step then calls fail() at lines 504-506 or 595-600, transitioning to failed with intent still 'pause'; the next tick filter admits any worker with a truthy intent (line 345) and applyControl sets 'paused' (lines 851-855). Reproduced (probe p4_stale_intent.ts, exit 0): control returned 'failed', next tick state=paused previous_state=failed, terminal? false, result available? no, VM retained, still paused after 5 more ticks. Sibling branches do clear intent (776-782, 895-905), so this is an inconsistency. No test drives control() concurrently with an in-flight step; tests/helpers.ts fakes resolve synchronously so the await window is never entered.

Verified-correct (no defect): 400 workers with MAX_WORKERS=50 / MAX_PROVISIONING=4 / MAX_QUEUE=1000 over 60 ticks gave peakProviderVms=50, peakProvisioningOrBooting=4, peakCapacityAccounted=50, peakConcurrentCreates=1, admittedInFifoOrder=true, states {running:50, queued:350}. The reservation counters are mutated synchronously within one runTick so nothing interleaves; ticking plus per-worker exclusive() prevent double createWorker. store.all() is ORDER BY rowid, giving strict global FIFO; per-team fairness is absent but docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:36 states teams are labels, not security tenants, so not reported. MAX_QUEUE boundary exact (5 accepted / 7 rejected at 5; cancelling a queued worker frees one slot). request_id retry idempotency correct under a full queue. bounded() timeouts cannot leak VMs: the freestyle provider is idempotent by slug (providers/freestyle.ts:44-47) and the worker keeps its reservation while retrying.

LIMITATIONS: all probes used injected local doubles - no cloud/model provider, no VM, no smoke run. MAX_WORKERS/MAX_PROVISIONING misconfiguration was traced by inspection only. The 300s ceiling was established by aging provision_started_at rather than a wall-clock wait. Full suite, packaging/build and scripts/smoke.ts were not run (other reviewers' scopes). All probe log lines were passed through the production Redactor (src/security.ts:43-50) before export; no canary survived; no secret files inspected.

result.followup_reason: Two reproducible MEDIUM admission/capacity defects at d428e0f73 need correction: (F1) count only workers that still need a new VM against SWARMFORGE_MAX_PROVISIONING so session revival cannot head-of-line block new admission for 300s - src/coordinator.ts:323-331, 238-243; (F2) add intent:null to the fail() transition at src/coordinator.ts:800-804 so a pause racing a terminal failure cannot resurrect a failed worker into a non-terminal, capacity-holding paused state. Add regression tests for both: the existing limit test only counts queued workers, and no test drives control() concurrently with an in-flight step().
